title: Fine-grained Contrastive Learning for Relation Extraction

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating end-to-end model performance on a specific subset of difficult, long-tail relation classes and reporting F1-macro scores to test if the learning-order denoising method disproportionately favors common, easier relation classes at the expense of rare ones.

Comparing batch-based learning order collection with epoch-based learning order collection to evaluate and mitigate the selection order bias introduced by the random sampling of batches during early training.
